title_block.title: Chamber 04 Temperature and Humidity Mapping Certificate
title_block.subtitle: ICH chamber programme, chamber mapping
lines: Mapping protocol and logger record: retained in the chamber file

blocks.p: This signed certificate records the temperature and relative humidity mapping acceptance checks for chamber 04. The mapping protocol, logger-position sheet and calibration references in the chamber file form the supporting record for the authorised storage conditions.

The authorised set points, loaded configuration and stabilised mapping interval are recorded in the chamber mapping protocol. This certificate does not extend use to a storage condition outside that qualification.

Logger positions for temperature and humidity are recorded on the signed position sheet. Read each logger trace against that location and its calibration reference; retain the position sheet with the mapping record.

Acceptance checks are made against the limits and evaluation interval in the approved mapping protocol. Temperature, relative humidity and any recovery checks must be evaluated under their respective protocol criteria.

list: Temperature traces checked against the protocol limits at the recorded logger positions
Relative humidity traces checked against the protocol limits at the recorded logger positions
Calibration references and logger identification checked against the position sheet

blocks.p: The signed acceptance record supports chamber 04 use within the conditions covered by the mapping protocol. Individual traces and acceptance checks remain in the chamber file; no additional runs or excursion results are reported by this certificate.

A probe serial-number entry was corrected by hand on the original logger record. The correction is initialled and dated; retain the original entry legibly and use the corrected identification with the associated calibration reference. The corrected serial number remains on the source record.

Chamber 04 is accepted for use within the storage conditions covered by the signed mapping record. Requalification and review follow the approved chamber procedure. This certificate does not qualify additional set points.
Calibration certificates for the loggers used in this mapping are filed in the instrument folder for chamber 04. Certificate numbers are recorded on the logger record sheet.
